{"id": "afb6719f-7d19-4556-a693-6c841ee7e4b0", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Before we merge PR #57 in acme/payments-infra, how much more or less will it cost per month? It deploys to eu-west-1.
The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.
--- PR #57 (chore/bump-db-class -> main), files changed ---
cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml   (+2 -2)
--- diff ---
@@ Parameters @@
   DbInstanceClass:
     Type: String
-    Default: db.r6g.large
+    Default: db.r6g.xlarge
@@ Resources.LedgerDb.Properties.Tags @@
       - Key: CostCenter
-        Value: payments
+        Value: payments-core
--- context (unchanged in this PR) ---
Resources.LedgerDb: AWS::RDS::DBInstance, DBInstanceClass: !Ref DbInstanceClass, Engine: postgres, MultiAZ: true, StorageType: gp3, AllocatedStorage: 200
.github/workflows/deploy.yml: AWS_REGION: eu-west-1; `aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger` with no --parameter-overrides (template defaults apply)
--- live lookup results for this run (AWS Price List, eu-west-1) ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large    databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-03  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.xlarge   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   1.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-04  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge        databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage       volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

{"id": "24493af3-40ee-4da0-9cc8-bc43ca389e97", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "This is a straightforward calculation, so I don't need delegation or special tools here—just work out the hourly rate difference using a standard monthly hours figure like 730 or 720, then apply it to the instance class change from db.r6g.

Looking at the pricing, the instance moves from large to xlarge Multi-AZ postgres, with the hourly rate doubling from $0.500 to $1.000; storage stays the same since the allocated GB doesn't change, so the only real cost delta comes from compute. Using 730 hours/month, that works out to roughly $365/month more, while the unused-box line and tag changes are irrelevant to the actual cost.

This is simple direct math, no delegation needed. I'll present the monthly increase clearly, noting my assumptions (730 hrs/month, storage unchanged, no deploy pipeline parameter overrides so the template default applies).

"}]}

{"id": "4dea31b1-fd5c-4047-89b2-fc9c527eb0ff", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Merging PR #57 bumps the `LedgerDb` RDS instance class via the template default (`db.r6g.large` → `db.r6g.xlarge`), and since the deploy workflow passes no `--parameter-overrides`, that new default will actually take effect on deploy. The `CostCenter` tag change has no cost impact.

**Cost impact (eu-west-1, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL):**

| Component | Before (large) | After (xlarge) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Compute (Multi-AZ hourly) | $0.500/hr | $1.000/hr | +$0.500/hr |
| Storage (200 GB gp3, Multi-AZ) | $50.00/mo | $50.00/mo | unchanged |

Using the standard 730 hrs/month:
- Compute before: 0.500 × 730 = **$365.00/mo**
- Compute after: 1.000 × 730 = **$730.00/mo**
- Storage (unaffected by this PR): 200 GB × $0.250 = **$50.00/mo** both before and after

**Total: $415.00/mo → $780.00/mo, an increase of ~$365.00/month (about +88%)**

This is driven entirely by the instance class doubling the Multi-AZ compute rate — storage is unchanged since `AllocatedStorage` wasn't touched in this diff.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

The `CostCenter` tag change has no cost impact.

**Cost impact (eu-west-1, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL):**

| Component | Before (large) | After (xlarge) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Compute (Multi-AZ hourly) | $0.500/hr | $1.000/hr | +$0.500/hr |
| Storage (200 GB gp3, Multi-AZ) | $50.00/mo | $50.00/mo | unchanged |

Using the standard 730 hrs/month:
- Compute before: 0.500 × 730 = **$365.00/mo**
- Compute after: 1.000 × 730 = **$730.00/mo**
- Storage (unaffected by this PR): 200 GB × $0.250 = **$50.00/mo** both before and after

**Total: $415.00/mo → $780.00/mo, an increase of ~$365.00/month (about +88%)**
